$comment: Structured-output contracts for review agents. scripts/build-skills.py writes each family's schema into the matching agents' frontmatter as `output:` (OMP agent field; see omp://task-agent-discovery.md) and --check fails when an agent's line drifts. Edit this file, then run the build. The prose report contracts in guides/document-review.md, guides/code-review.md, and guides/prompt-design.md define what each field must contain.

target.description: Reviewed document path, document-set identity, or candidate identity.

revision.description: Exact revision, hash, or unambiguous candidate label; identify each member's revision for a document set.

scope.description: Review scope, including the feature, slice, or whole-set or focused coherence scope when applicable.

independent.description: True for an independent first pass; false when prior review context was visible.

coverage.description: Derived map, sources and evidence inspected, and checks limited by unavailable material.

findings.description: Unique unresolved supported findings; the count is the array length.

location.description: Exact location; both locations for an ownership conflict.

evidence.description: Quoted candidate text, or for an omission the expected rule and the sections inspected.

governingEvidence.description: Quoted governing source when the finding depends on it.

correction.description: Smallest correction, disposition, or focused decision question.

questions.description: Consequential unknowns not established as defects.

coverageLimits.description: Unavailable evidence and exactly which checks it prevents.

nextAction.description: One concrete revision, source retrieval, focused decision, or rereview step; never acceptance.

technology.description: Target technology and scope actually reviewed.

candidate.description: Candidate revision, working-tree snapshot, or base..target.

coverage.description: Target code and connected context actually inspected.

findings.description: Supported findings in impact order; the count is the array length.

location.description: Precise path and line, or symbol.

evidence.description: Observed evidence and the contract or engineering rationale; for Blocker or Major, begin with the verbatim triggering line(s) and their path:line.

correction.description: Smallest corrective direction with any meaningful tradeoff.

checksRun.description: Checks actually executed, verbatim, with results.

checksNotRun.description: Proposed or skipped verification, kept separate from executed checks.

coverageLimits.description: Uninspected targets, features, or missing caller evidence.

sourceRevision.description: Exact editable source revision, hash, or unambiguous body label.

skillRevision.description: Exact generated-skill revision or unambiguous body label.

reviewBasis.description: Intended contract, source and generated-skill provenance, evidence records, shared guidance, and research consulted.

findings.description: Supported findings; the count is the array length.

evidenceRecord.description: Evidence record and exact observed success or failure, for a behavioral finding.

causalTrace.description: How the text caused or enabled the result, or why causation cannot be established.

consequence.description: Practical consequence against the intended contract.

edit.description: Smallest specific edit in the owning source.

owner.description: Editable owner: source, shared guide, publisher, agent description or routing case, or adaptation.

sharedGuidanceImpact.description: When shared guidance is implicated: known consumer scope, behavior served, and the cross-prompt impact review required.

evidenceAccounting.description: Every material supplied observation and its disposition.

nextAction.description: One focused source correction, missing evidence request, or decision; never an edit.
